analysis:
Every unit in this batch is documentation-only. CHANGELOG.md has a head-side excerpt of lines 4195-4958 (older historical release notes), and the patch shows a new v0.10.8 candidate section at head lines 11-333. Four changelog.d fragments were removed: app-attest-attestation-survives-disconnect, app-attest-launchservices-refresh, ci-git-swiftpm-cache and ci-macos-darkbloom-route. A fifth, cli-darkbloom-look, has metadata only and an empty-file unit, so I could not inspect its content beyond the patch excerpt of its removal. No executable source, protocol code, key handling, attestation verification, cache crypto or authorization logic is touched, so no security control changes in this batch.

Removed fragments of security interest: the App Attest survive-disconnect and LaunchServices-refresh notes (A-015/A-016, TB-011, T-057). They document behavior that is presumably folded into the new CHANGELOG v0.10.8 section. I could not verify that fold-in from the supplied excerpt, which is truncated. Removal of the fragments does not alter behavior.

The CHANGELOG head excerpt for lines 4195-4958 shows historical prefix-cache SSD checkpoint notes (T-041 context). They describe encrypted SSD storage, tenant scope and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate. These lines appear unchanged, since the changed head range is 11-333, so they are pre-existing and not a new regression.

Remaining questions for integration are the code changes behind the v0.10.8 changelog claims, which are outside this batch. The pair-update flow, the App Attest unsupported-state refresh using lsregister, and the 64-approval cluster limit all need review against the actual source diffs. No findings are raised here because the evidence is documentation only.
